newsitem.title: USA: Kerr gets $48 mln financing to repay debt.
newsitem.headline: Kerr gets $48 mln financing to repay debt.

text.p: Kerr Group Inc said Thursday it has executed a commitment letter for $48 million in financing to allow it to restructure its debts.
Besides refinancing the company's accounts receivables facility, Kerr Group said the financing will provide $29.3 million to repay a portion of its existing $50.9 million indebtedness.
It received the $48 million financing from CIT Group/Business Credit Inc.

The company said it also has agreed with its existing lenders to exchange the balance of its existing debt for new secured subordinated notes, in the aggregate principal amount of $12 million, and shares of convertible preferred stock.
The subordinated notes will bear interest at a rate of 10 percent a year, but will be "pay-in-kind" during the first three years, it said.
The preferred stock will be convertible into about 748,000 shares of common stock and will have a liquidation preference of $13 million, but will have no stated dividends.
After the restructuring, Kerr Group expects to have about $10 million of additional borrowing availability.
